title: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus
summary: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus, formerly Victoria Terminus, is a railway station in Mumbai designed by the British architect F. W. Stevens in Victorian Gothic Revival style with Indian influences. Building began in 1878 and took about ten years; it is a UNESCO World Heritage property and still serves over three million commuters daily.

uncertainty.note: UNESCO says construction began in 1878 and lasted ten years; Incredible India says completed in 1887.
